libs.note: BH-5799. The plan thread gate: a plan that does not cite, by comment id, a ticket comment by a person or this fleet's App that is newer than the plan is refused. Call site A in bin/lib/rb/plan.sh refuses a reused or adopted plan and plans fresh in the same run; call site B at the top of rb_review in bin/lib/rb/review.sh ends the build PLAN_STALE with plan.md moved aside. GitHub-issue projects only; an in-app board answers n/a. An unreadable thread fails open. Resolved by ptg_enforce with lib_env_apply plan-thread.

knobs.zero_means: warn only: log the uncited comments and continue
knobs.note: 1 = refuse a plan that misses a newer comment. 0 is the kill switch: one PLAN_THREAD_WARN line in pipeline.log and the build continues. Anything ptg_enforce cannot resolve reads as 1.
